description: This is a Java test class for the ReadingGoalCalculator utility, containing unit tests that validate various functions related to reading goals and schedule calculations. It includes test methods for progress computation, schedule comparisons, and date-related logic with mocked utilities.

classes.name: ReadingGoalCalculatorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for ReadingGoalCalculator, testing progress calculation, schedule comparison, and date-in-year logic.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes mocked static DateUtils object before all tests.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Closes mocked static DateUtils object after all tests.

methods.name: calculateCorrectProgressValue
methods.description: Tests that calculateProgressTowardsReadingGoal computes the correct progress value given books to read and books read.

methods.name: calculateCorrectProgressValueWhenGoalMet
methods.description: Tests that progress is 1.0 when books read equals books to read.

methods.name: calculateCorrectProgressValueWhenGoalExceeded
methods.description: Tests that progress is capped at 1.0 when books read exceeds books to read.

methods.name: testNoProgressMadeTowardsGoal
methods.description: Tests that progress is zero when no books have been read.

methods.name: notAttemptToDivideByZeroInCalculateProgressTowardsReadingGoal
methods.description: Ensures the function handles the case where books to read is zero without throwing an exception, returning zero progress.

methods.name: shouldNotThrowExceptionOnZeroDivision
methods.description: Softly asserts that the calculation does not throw and correctly returns zero when books to read is zero.

methods.name: behindSchedule
methods.description: Nested test: verifies that the schedule calculation indicates being behind when no books are read early in the year.

methods.name: onSchedule
methods.description: Nested test: verifies schedule calculation shows on schedule after reading 1 book out of 52.

methods.name: aheadOfSchedule
methods.description: Nested test: verifies calculation shows being ahead when more books than planned are read early in the year.

methods.name: setWeekToMiddleOfYear
methods.description: Setup method changing current week number to middle of the year for tests.

methods.name: setLastWeekOfYear
methods.description: Setup method changing current week number to last week of the year for tests.

methods.name: testBooksToReadFromStartOfYear
methods.description: Verifies that booksToReadFromStartOfYear returns the fractional year progress.

methods.name: returnFalseInBookHasFinishDateThisYearIfBookIsNull
methods.description: Checks that null book returns false for finish date in current year.

methods.name: returnFalseIfBookDoesNotHaveAFinishDate
methods.description: Verifies false when a Book has no finish date.

methods.name: returnFalseIfBookNotReadThisYear
methods.description: Verifies false if the book was finished in a previous year.

methods.name: returnTrueIfBookReadThisYear
methods.description: Verifies true if the book was finished in the current year.
